import { connectClient, type Actor } from "@agentorg/cli/actor";
import {
  BUILTINS,
  DirectoryActor,
  Message,
  Work,
  Form,
  Position,
  Team,
  SystemStatus,
  SystemConnection,
  SystemProvider,
  ConnectionPage,
  ProviderPage,
  ConnectionDisconnected,
  Diagnostic,
  type Answer,
  type ToolDescriptor,
} from "@agentorg/cli/contract";
import { z } from "zod";
const message: z.output<typeof Message> = BUILTINS.message_send.response.parse({});
const sender: string = message.senderID;
const work: z.output<typeof Work> = BUILTINS.work_create.response.parse({});
const owner: string = work.ownerID;
const form: z.output<typeof Form> = BUILTINS.form_create.response.parse({});
const respondents: string[] = form.respondentIDs;
const directory: z.output<typeof DirectoryActor> = BUILTINS.actor_get.response.parse({});
const actorID: string = directory.actorID;
const team: z.output<typeof Team> = BUILTINS.team.response.parse({});
const position: z.output<typeof Position> | undefined = team.positions[0];
const linked = BUILTINS.form_create.request.parse({
  respondentIDs: ["actor"],
  fields: [{ name: "answer", label: "Answer", required: true }],
});
const optionalWork: string | undefined = linked.workID;
const client: Promise<Actor> = connectClient({
  url: "http://127.0.0.1:1",
  actorId: "actor",
  credential: "fixture",
});
const tools: Promise<ToolDescriptor[]> = client.then((actor) => actor.available());
const answer: Promise<Answer> = client.then((actor) => actor.call("message_list", { after: 0 }));
void [sender, owner, respondents, actorID, position, optionalWork, tools, answer];

const workQuery = BUILTINS.work_list.request.parse({
  ownerID: "owner",
  requesterID: "requester",
  ownerWithin: "owner-branch",
  requesterWithin: "requester-branch",
  status: "submitted",
});
const ownerID: string | undefined = workQuery.ownerID;
const requesterID: string | undefined = workQuery.requesterID;
const ownerWithin: string | undefined = workQuery.ownerWithin;
const requesterWithin: string | undefined = workQuery.requesterWithin;
const status:
  | "open"
  | "active"
  | "blocked"
  | "submitted"
  | "changes_requested"
  | "accepted"
  | undefined = workQuery.status;
const formQuery = BUILTINS.form_list.request.parse({
  workID: "work",
  requesterID: "requester",
  respondentID: "respondent",
  status: "open",
  awaitingActorID: "awaiting",
  requesterWithin: "requester-branch",
  respondentWithin: "respondent-branch",
  awaitingWithin: "awaiting-branch",
});
const formFilters: (string | undefined)[] = [
  formQuery.workID,
  formQuery.requesterID,
  formQuery.respondentID,
  formQuery.status,
  formQuery.awaitingActorID,
  formQuery.requesterWithin,
  formQuery.respondentWithin,
  formQuery.awaitingWithin,
];
const listedMessage: z.output<typeof Message> | undefined = BUILTINS.message_list.response.parse({})
  .items[0];
const listedWork: z.output<typeof Work> | undefined = BUILTINS.work_list.response.parse({})
  .items[0];
const listedForm: z.output<typeof Form> | undefined = BUILTINS.form_list.response.parse({})
  .items[0];
void [ownerID, requesterID, ownerWithin, requesterWithin, status, formFilters, listedMessage, listedWork, listedForm];

const typedWorkFilter: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.work_list.request> = { ownerWithin: "branch" };
const typedFormFilter: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.form_list.request> = { awaitingWithin: "branch" };
// @ts-expect-error Subtree anchors are Actor IDs, not numbers.
const invalidWorkFilter: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.work_list.request> = { ownerWithin: 1 };
// @ts-expect-error Subtree anchors are Actor IDs, not booleans.
const invalidFormFilter: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.form_list.request> = { awaitingWithin: true };
void [typedWorkFilter, typedFormFilter, invalidWorkFilter, invalidFormFilter];

const hub: z.output<typeof SystemStatus> = BUILTINS.system_status.response.parse({});
const instance: string = hub.instanceId;
const observations: z.output<typeof Diagnostic>[] = hub.diagnostics.items;
const connectionPage: z.output<typeof ConnectionPage> = BUILTINS.connection_list.response.parse({});
const connection: z.output<typeof SystemConnection> | undefined = connectionPage.items[0];
const providerPage: z.output<typeof ProviderPage> = BUILTINS.provider_list.response.parse({});
const provider: z.output<typeof SystemProvider> | undefined = providerPage.items[0];
const detached: z.output<typeof ConnectionDisconnected> = BUILTINS.connection_disconnect.response.parse({});
const closed: true = detached.closed;
const connectionQuery: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.connection_list.request> = { actorId: "actor", instanceId: instance, limit: 1 };
const providerQuery: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.provider_list.request> = { connected: false };
// @ts-expect-error Provider connected is an explicit boolean.
const invalidProviderQuery: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.provider_list.request> = { connected: "false" };
// @ts-expect-error Detach binds both the exact answering run and connection.
const invalidDetach: z.input<typeof BUILTINS.connection_disconnect.request> = { connectionId: "connection" };
void [observations, connection, provider, closed, connectionQuery, providerQuery, invalidProviderQuery, invalidDetach];
